sectionHeading: Case study: Creo Gedania — 10 new students from two reels

hero.imageAlt: Students and a teacher in front of the Creo Gedania school building in Gdańsk
hero.heading: How we won 10 new students for Creo Gedania with two reels

intro.heading: Small classes, a niche audience, one precise shot
intro.body1: Creo Gedania is a modern school on Gdańsk's education map, known for its small classes and focus on well-rounded child development. Ahead of its upcoming Open Days, the school needed an effective way to reach a very specific niche — parents of school-age children across the Tri-City area (Gdańsk, Gdynia, Sopot).
intro.body2: Goal: promote Open Days and recruit new students. The solution needed to guarantee precise reach, build credibility for the school, and engage the local community immediately.

challengeChapter.label: 01 — The challenge
challengeChapter.heading: How do you reach parents without burning budget outside the region?

strategyChapter.label: 02 — Strategy & execution
strategyChapter.heading: A script, a creator, and precise ads.

niche.title: Hit a very narrow niche
niche.body: Parents of school-age children living in the Tri-City area. Broad, traditional ad campaigns risked burning budget on people outside the region.

trust.title: Build credibility and local engagement
trust.body: Ahead of Open Days, the school needed a format that would instantly build trust and engage the local community — not another ad banner.

script.title: A script written for one goal
script.body: After consulting with the school's leadership, our team wrote a precise script — strongly emphasizing the individual approach to each student and presenting the school as a genuinely one-of-a-kind school by any international standard. Instead of a dry announcement: an authentic story.

creator.title: A local creator, the right community
creator.body: We selected micro-influencer @poznajtrojmiasto for the campaign — a creator active on TikTok and Instagram whose audience is almost an exact overlap with our target group.

ads.title: Boosted with Meta Ads and TikTok Ads
ads.body: We backed the published videos with precisely targeted paid ads, reaching exactly the selected group of Tri-City parents and ensuring the highest-quality views.

resultsBlock.heading: Two reels, ten new students.
resultsBlock.headlineStatLabel: new students enrolled after watching the videos
resultsBlock.secondaryStatLabel: targeted views from the synergy of organic reach and Meta/TikTok Ads
resultsBlock.qualitativeHighlight: The campaign generated strong interest in the event and built real offline traffic — parents visited the school with their children even before official enrollment opened.

outro.line1: Precise planning in local marketing works like a scalpel.
outro.line2: Client: Creo Gedania. Strategic consulting, script, creator selection, and targeted ad support — 10 new, full-tuition enrollments from two video pieces.
